title: myroxylon senticosum
intro: Myroxylon senticosum, commonly known as Palo Santo, is a plant species native to the Gran Chaco region of South America. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to relieve stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Palo Santo include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular natural remedy for pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Palo Santo include limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and guaiacol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
